create_GreedyGeodesicFollower: create a GreedyGeodesicFollower instance with a PathFinder and Agent to plan geodesic shortest path navigation
next_action_along_goal: get the next action to take along the geodesic shortest path from the agent to a goal position
find_path_to_goal: find the full sequence of actions to navigate from the agent current position to a goal position
reset_follower_state: reset the GreedyGeodesicFollower internal state and clear the last tracked goal position
configure_action_keys: configure custom action keys for stop forward left and right movements in the GreedyGeodesicFollower constructor
